definitions.explanation: An official endorsement on a passport permitting entry to or exit from a country. The formal Japanese term for what is commonly called ビザ in everyday speech.

examples.japanese: {査証|さしょう}を{申請|しんせい}する。
{入国|にゅうこく}には{有効|ゆうこう}な{査証|さしょう}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: A valid visa is required for entry.

examples.japanese: {査証|さしょう}{免除|めんじょ}{協定|きょうてい}により、{短期|たんき}{滞在|たいざい}ならビザなしで{渡航|とこう}できる。
examples.english: Thanks to the visa exemption agreement, you can travel without a visa for short stays.

notes: The formal/official term for visa. In everyday conversation, ビザ is far more common; {査証|さしょう} appears in government documents, news, and legal contexts. Common collocations: {査証|さしょう}を{申請|しんせい}する (to apply for a visa), {査証|さしょう}を{取得|しゅとく}する (to obtain a visa), {査証|さしょう}{免除|めんじょ} (visa exemption). Related compounds: {就労|しゅうろう}ビザ (work visa), {観光|かんこう}ビザ (tourist visa).
